### 1. Scene
An Asian-style meal: three maki sushi pieces and one fresh rice-paper roll on a side plate, plus a bowl of vegetables topped with golden strips that appear to be fried tofu. Water is excluded.

### 2. Vessels
- **Side plate:** approximately 20 cm diameter → area ≈ **314 cm²**.
- **Shallow bowl:** approximately 20 cm diameter → area ≈ **314 cm²**.

### 3. Items
- Maki sushi with rice, seaweed, avocado and a pale fish-like filling.
- Fresh rice-paper roll with vegetables and a pale filling.
- Golden fried tofu strips, identification uncertain.
- Shredded cabbage, carrot and red pepper.
- Fresh herbs.
- A little visible dressing coating the salad.

The filled rolls are estimated as complete items rather than counting their fillings separately.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight and energy
Heights below are average heights across each item's allocated footprint. Area shares are non-overlapping estimates.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Three maki pieces | 17% of plate | 53.4 × 2.0 = 107 ml | 0.95 | 101 g | 155 | 157 kcal |
| Rice-paper roll | 23% of plate | 72.2 × 2.0 = 144 ml | 0.75 | 108 g | 110 | 119 kcal |
| Fried tofu strips | 28% of bowl | 87.9 × 1.1 = 97 ml | 0.90 | 87 g | 240 | 209 kcal |
| Mixed vegetables | 22% of bowl | 69.1 × 1.5 = 104 ml | 0.60 | 62 g | 30 | 19 kcal |
| Fresh herbs | 4% of bowl | 12.6 × 1.5 = 19 ml | 0.15 | 3 g | 25 | 1 kcal |
| Dressing | 2% of bowl | 6.3 × 0.8 = 5 ml | 1.00 | 5 g | 300 | 15 kcal |

**Coverage check:** approximately **40% of the side plate** and **56% of the bowl** are allocated to food.

### 8. Sanity check
The estimate is **366 g and about 520 kcal**. This is plausible for three substantial sushi pieces, one fresh roll and a modest tofu-and-vegetable salad. The largest uncertainty is the identity and oil content of the golden strips.
